_rationale.basis: Measured from E00's task commits, counting authored files only and excluding package-lock.json and project/ board Markdown. Observed range per task: 1-7 files, 21-150 lines.
_rationale.inline_max_files: 5. Every E00 task except the tsconfig/App-Router one stayed at or under this. Past roughly five files a change stops being a single edit and starts being something worth isolating so it can be reviewed and reverted as a unit.
_rationale.inline_max_lines: 150. The largest single authored task in E00 was 86 lines; 150 leaves headroom without admitting work too big to hold in one sitting.
_rationale.story_max_files: 20. A whole story's tasks bundled together. E00's largest story touches roughly 10-15 files, so this allows a genuine bundle while still catching one that has run away.
_rationale.bundle_lock_ttl_minutes: 120. This is stale-lock recovery, not a work timeout. Long enough that a legitimately slow multi-task bundle is never evicted mid-run, short enough that a crashed agent frees the story within a working session.
